titulo: Germany urges EU to cut Russians’ holiday visas after sabotage attacks
cuerpo: Belarusian said to have had tourist visa issued by Italy is investigated over alleged attempt to attack Leipzig airport Germany is urging its European partners to introduce tighter limitations on Russian citizens entering the EU on tourist visas, after recent sabotage attacks which Berlin has blamed on Moscow . German authorities are investigating a Belarusian national, who also holds a Russian passport, over the alleged attempt to attack Leipzig airport using drones and explosives. Continue reading...
